name: Onoha Mespos
source:
Onoha is a pirate originally from Zeth. She wears a cat ears pirate hat adorned with a skull and crossbones, a right eye patch and a pirate cape adorned with gold plates. However, behind these things she wears very little clothing, having only a small bathing suit exposed with her cape falling in a messy fashion, looking half-naked. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Onoha_Mespos]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
